plugins.name: jurimetria-lab
plugins.description: Operator-mode skills + agents for the Themia jurimetria lab. Hypothesis-driven experiments, per-decision reviews, cohort-scale resolution loops, and rapport synthesis — all chunk-cited, French-audited, MCP-bound.

plugins.name: croissance-lab
plugins.description: Themia's growth lab — Themia-native skills (positioning, discovery, channels, French copy, webinars) + a croissance-router entry point + 11 founder-playbook frameworks (offers, leads, pricing, SPIN, influence, blue ocean, chasm, four steps, lean startup, made-to-stick, storybrand) as reference depth. Sibling to jurimetria-lab: jurimetria-lab produces the verified truth, croissance-lab distributes it.

plugins.name: leadership-lab
plugins.description: Themia's leadership lab — how the founder/leader runs Themia. Operational capture: feature-request, bug-report, analytics-report and decision file Themia work straight into Linear (principe 7.1 révisé); decision keeps the sealed doc in the repo where secretariat can verify it and publishes a Linear pointer carrying the docHash. People side: no-rules-rules ports the Freedom & Responsibility model tuned to Themia. Corporate side: themia-pv drafts procès-verbaux of the décisions collectives des associés. Money side: /runway gives a cashflow / renewals / TVA / trough snapshot.
